purpose: Teach: 茎/世俗/パラダイム/フェミニズム/中南米/遠距離/金星/生死

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、漢方の薬草の茎部分を医療チームで活用します
lines.en: Ren — we'll use herbal stem preparations across the medical team.
lines.style: Steady, measured opening. Clinical confidence without coldness. Direct eye contact. Even pace, clear articulation of each component.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、世俗の患者にも宗教的患者にも医療チームで配慮します
lines.en: Yes — we make sure to consider both secular and religious patients across our entire care approach.
lines.style: Gentle firmness. A slight warm lift on the affirmation. Unhurried pace. The tone of someone who has thought about this deeply and is comfortable saying it.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、診断のパラダイム転換を医療チームで検討します
lines.en: Ren — we're reconsidering our diagnostic framework as a team.
lines.style: Deliberate pause before the key phrase. Clinical tone with underlying humility. Not defensive about the shift — matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、フェミニズム視点の医療を医療チームで意識します
lines.en: Yes — we're bringing feminist perspectives into our medical practice across the team.
lines.style: Steady, neither apologetic nor emphatic. Professional weight on the commitment. Warm underneath the clinical language.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 中南米から来日の患者を、貴院、診られますね、先生
lines.en: You see patients coming from Central and South America at your hospital, don't you, Doctor?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity with respect. Slight hesitation — testing whether this is a fair question. Soft landing on the honorific, not forced.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、遠距離通院患者の負担を医療チームで軽減します
lines.en: Yes — we work to reduce the burden on patients who travel long distances for care.
lines.style: Patient, warm. A slight nod in the voice to the unspoken difficulty. Even delivery. The reassurance of someone who understands the weight.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 金星探査の隊員医療を、貴院、関係されますね、先生
lines.en: Does your hospital work with astronauts' medical care — for space missions, I mean?
lines.style: Gentle awkwardness here — he's reaching a bit, testing the scope of her practice. Soft, genuine wonder. Not performing sophistication.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、生死の境にある患者を医療チームで支えます
lines.en: Yes — we support patients at the edge of life and death with all we have as a team.
lines.style: Quiet gravity. Long, steady breath underneath. No performance — this is what matters. Slight trailing softness, like a door closing gently.
